## SEPSIS WITH SUSPECTED PNEUMONIA
Consider consulting Infectious Diseases if pneumonia is not strongly suspected
as the source of infection.
Empirical regimens listed below have broad coverage of likely pathogens based on
infectious site. Resistant gram-negative rods and MRSA coverage is not necessary
in most patients except those with recent isolates of these organisms. Strongly
consider rapid de-escalation of therapy in the first 24-48 hours based on MRSA
nares, isolated pathogen(s), and patient response to therapy. Refer to pathogen
specific sections of the Antimicrobial CDSS for additional treatment
recommendations.
## Nosocomial pneumonia preferred treatment
Recommend discontinuing vancomycin if MRSA nares return negative.
[Piperacillin/tazobactam 4.5 gm IV q6H <AND> vancomycin 15 mg/kg IV q12H](orz-set-abx-sepsis-pip-tazo-ne-extinf-ci-cefep-metro-vanco)
## Community acquired pneumonia preferred treatment
[Ceftriaxone 2gm IV q24H <AND> azithromycin 500 mg IV once then 250mg IV q24H for](orz-set-abx-sepsis-ceftriaxone-2gm-iv-azithro-500mg-250mg-iv)
4 days
Recent Pseudomonas isolate:
[Piperacillin/tazobactam 4.5 gm IV q6H <AND> azithromycin 500 mg IV once then](orz-set-abx-sepsis-pip-tazo-ne-extinf-ci-cefep-metro-azithro)
250mg IV q24H for 4 days
## For penicillin allergy in nosocomial and community acquired pneumonia
[<SUBSTITUTE> Cefepime 2 gm IV q8h for Beta-lactam in regimen above](psjizid-cefepime-2-gm-iv-q8h-sepsis)
## Severe beta-lactam reaction
[Treatment of Sepsis with Severe Beta-Lactam Reaction](orzc-gmenu-sepsis-severe-beta-lactam-reaction)
## Recent MRSA isolate
[<ADD> Vancomycin 15 mg/kg IV q12h to one of the above regimens](orz-set-abx-vanco-sepsis-15mg-kg-q12h-mrsa-nares-screening)
## Clinically unstable (ICU level care/hypotensive/tachycardic) AND recent multi-
## drug resistant gram-negative rod isolate
[<ADD> Tobramycin 5 mg/kg IV x 1 dose to one of the above regimens](psjizid-tobramycin-5-mg-kg-iv-sepsis)
*If CrCl less than 50 ml/min: 2 mg/kg x 1 dose (use order above and modify dose)
Pharmacy to follow
## Consider selecting alternative agents from separate drug class if recently
## treated with any of the above antibiotics.

## ER

Guidance
## Nosocomial pneumonia preferred treatment
Piperacillin/tazobactam 4.5 gm IV once STAT <AND> vancomycin 15 mg/kg IV once
STAT
## Community acquired pneumonia preferred treatment
Ceftriaxone 2gm IV once STAT <AND> azithromycin 500 mg IV once STAT
Recent Pseudomonas isolate:
Piperacillin/tazobactam 4.5 gm IV once STAT <AND> azithromycin 500 mg IV once
## Recent MRSA isolate
<ADD> Vancomycin 15 mg/kg IV once STAT to one of the above regimens
## drug resistant gram-negative rod isolate
<ADD> Tobramycin 5 mg/kg IV once STAT to one of the above regimens
*If CrCl < 50 ml/min: 2 mg/kg once STAT (use order above and modify dose)
